infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VibeMeter measures ambient sound levels to compute vibe scores. No audio is recorded or stored.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VibeMeter uses your location to detect when you arrive at and leave venues.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: VibeMeter tracks your location in the background to measure how long you stay at a venue.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: VibeMeter scans for nearby Bluetooth devices to estimate crowd density. No device identities are stored.
